sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What did the thirsty crow drop into the pitcher to make the water rise?
Choose the correct plural form of the word 'brush'.
According to the poem 'Little Drops of Water', what do little drops of water make?
Identify the describing word (adjective) in this sentence: 'The green frog jumped high.'
Which of these is the national bird of India?
Choose the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: '___ are going to the park to play.'
When you look up at 'A Show of Clouds', what can you use to guess the shapes?
Which joining word (conjunction) fits best? 'I like apples ___ bananas.'
Where in your town would you go to buy stamps or mail a letter?
Choose the correct position word (preposition): 'The cat is sleeping ___ the table.'
How did the smart monkey trick the crocodile in the story?
questions.answer: The monkey tricked the crocodile by telling him that he left his heart back on the tree.

questions.question_text: Without seeing, how can you guess that it is raining outside? Mention two senses.
questions.answer: I can hear the pitter-patter sound of the rain and smell the fresh wet earth.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence with capital letters and a full stop: 'my name is rahul and i live in delhi'
questions.answer: My name is Rahul and I live in Delhi.

questions.question_text: Why do we write 'Come Back Soon' letters to our family members?
questions.answer: We write these letters to tell our family that we miss them and want them to return home.

questions.question_text: Name two important places you see between your home and your school.
questions.answer: I see a big community park and a local grocery store on my way to school.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct Articles (A, An, The): 1. I saw ___ elephant at the zoo. 2. ___ sun shines brightly in the sky. 3. She has ___ red bicycle.
Match the Proper Nouns with their Common Nouns: 1. Diwali, 2. Ganga, 3. Amit. Options -> a) River, b) Boy, c) Festival.
questions.answer: 1 matches with c (Festival), 2 matches with a (River), 3 matches with b (Boy).

questions.question_text: Imagine you have a magic bicycle that can fly. Where will it take you and what will you do there? Write 3-4 sentences.
questions.answer: My magic bicycle has shiny silver wings. It will fly me high into the sky, all the way to the moon. I will play hide and seek with the twinkling stars. Before it gets dark, I will fly back home for dinner.

questions.question_text: Think about your perfect town. Describe what you see in your neighborhood when you look out of your window.
questions.answer: In my perfect town, I see a beautiful park with a giant red slide and swings. There is an ice cream shop next to a big, quiet library. The streets are very clean, and children are laughing and playing safely together.
